findings.detail: max_context_chars was preserved as text-unit limit; full serialized envelope is separately bounded by max_payload_bytes.
Missing or malformed usage leaves the reservation unknown and blocks tools, retries, repair edits and later requests; it is never treated as zero or refunded.
Session tool results follow their matching call, and ContextProjection rejects orphan, duplicate, missing and out-of-order tool results.
Memory read-modify-write holds one lock and uses unique temporary files; concurrent tests accept only all-success or explicit busy.
Task-state prompts handle command-only dependency rows without dereferencing a null policy; command evidence remains a separate authority from file evidence.
Known input/output usage replaces the input/output estimate against whole-task headroom; an actual overrun remains recorded and blocks later work.
Budgeted report/checkpoint resume is refused before work until a historical ledger can be bound; unbudgeted resume remains available.
Memory result selection budgets whole records against the final JSON envelope and can omit every unfit record instead of forcing one oversized match.
A budgeted provider transport failure marks usage unknown and cannot consume a fresh retry or fallback allowance.
Malformed provider usage is validated before arithmetic, marks the shared ledger unknown, and refuses subsequent reservations.
